result:
I shipped three Settings and Keys changes, but the critic still scores Settings at 2 out of 5, and I only re-scored screen 26, so the task is partial.

I didn't re-shoot or re-score the other screens (18, 25, 27–31, 42, 49, 68–75). I also didn't re-score the Keys window (32) after the two changes that touch it. Earlier runs left 25, 42 and 49 at 3 and 32 at 2. Nothing is at 4 yet.

What shipped, all through the gate with the seed 4242 fingerprint unchanged:
- **v29.63:** the Settings and Keys card widths now use size tokens instead of fixed pixel values. The ui-shared pin check forces this.
- **v29.64:** the key rows in Keys get a raised fill and an amber bar on hover, matching Settings.
- **v29.65:** Settings had two stacked tab strips. "Send play data" is now the last chip of the section strip, and the title tabs hide on the Game page. They show only on the Send play data page, so the way back is still there.

On screen 26 the critic says the result is better than before but still a 2. These are its open P1s:
- Controls sit about 700px from their labels, against a 400px limit.
- Type sizes drift across 14, 15 and 18px.
- There is no footer hint strip or Done button.
- The list ends mid-row with no fade.
- The detail pane is mostly empty.

I left the "So you are too good for default settings, eh?" subtitle alone, because it is his line. The critic flags it, but the rule is not to reword or delete his lines.

What blocks a 4 is the shared modal shell: a centred 960×680 card and a 48×48 header X on every modal. That needs its own task, not a pause or settings one. My next steps if this is resumed are in my notes file: narrow the Settings list so controls sit within 400px of labels, add a fade at the bottom of the list, and enlarge the header X.

Notes are in `c-31-ui-pause-settings.md`, and I logged the visible change in `ui/changes.md`. Pictures are in `notes/shots/c-31k-before` and `c-31l-after`, `c-31m-after`, `c-31n-after`.

TASK PARTIAL: Settings (26) scores 2/5 and the other screens were not re-scored. Still open are the Settings control distance, type scale and footer hints, plus the shared modal shell (a centred 960×680 card and a header X) for a separate task.
